title: The orchestrator's Order names the one-pass fix round
findings_note: s373 relay review 2026-10-18: v7's ORCHESTRATOR_RULES gained "a small fix round is reviewed and gated in one pass", but Order step 2 still reads "review, then accepted findings back to the implementer for each fix round, ... then the gate" with no pointer to that exception
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing either rule; a contract bump (this is a rewording, so `RELAY_CONTRACT` stays 7).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: An orchestrator that reads Order alone runs a separate gate round after every small fix round, against the v7 rule in Rules. Order should say where the exception applies.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the test; watch it go red.
2. Add to Order step 2: "(a small fix round is reviewed and gated in one pass; see Rules)". Keep the report under 30 lines.
3. CHANGELOG; mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
